newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS confirms Avenor debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBRS confirms Avenor debt ratings.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service on Monday said it reaffirmed the bond ratings of Avenor Inc's senior unsecured notes and debentures at B+(High) and subordinated convertible debentures at B(High).
The bond rating service said it also assigned a positive rating outlook to the securities.

CBRS said despite the current weakness in Avenor's results, the company is continuing to make progress in reducing its debt, an element which has negatively impacted its credit quality for the past five years.

With the improvement in liquidity, the reduction in total debt and the company's established market presence, Avenor is in a stronger position to weather the current market weakness and to take advantage of future opportunities, CBRS said.
The agency said while debt reduction is expected to remain a major focus point for the future, the company is now able to prudently explore growth opportunities.
